meta.name: Indestructible Man
meta.description:
Betrayed by his fellow criminals, Lon Chaney, Jr. is executed, but has his chance for revenge when he is reanimated by a scientist. (This copy seems to have no gaps.) Find out more at the IMDB.

(The video is interlaced in the MPEG2 file. If viewing with VLC, deinterlace with menu-path Video/Deinterlace/Blend.)

The mpeg2 file can be loaded into DVDAuthorGUI (a free program) to create a DVD.
